move: five multiply-blend circles orbit on ellipses and breathe, stacking order flips
how: Five 420px flat-colour circles with mix-blend-mode multiply on cream, each on its own ellipse (radii 180 to 260 by 90 to 150) at one orbit per loop, alternating direction, phased a fifth apart, with scale 1 plus 0.18*sin at two pulses per loop and a zIndex that follows the orbit depth so the stacking order rolls. Everything is computed from t in a seek function via gsap.set, so t=D equals t=0. A small label and ring mark are static.
adapt: Change the five circle colours (multiply wants saturated primaries on a light ground), the circle size, the label; keep integer orbit and pulse counts per loop.
port: mount(el, shot) appends the .c circles and label; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one {t:0->D, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) gsap.set calls. Scope querySelectorAll('.c') to el.
